text_block_list.text:
I'm discussing future plans
with Agnes Digital, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm okay!
My head's just throbbing a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... This is all because of my slump.
I just can't seem to piece together ideas for the new release..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The other day, I happened to see
two Umamusume in the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A senpai carrying an injured kouhai in her arms...! 
Alone together in the nurse's office! And as the kouhai lets out her vulnerabilities, the comforting senpai—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...I got that far in my thoughts, but then I hit a wall with the plot...
And my head's starting to hurt...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gwah... Ouch...! Daydreaming again, and look what happened...

I wasn't really sure, but she seemed to be overthinking it...
After that, she continued to be plagued by headaches.
